game_consent.title: 🎮 Game Terms Agreement
game_consent.desc:
Before using any game features (**Pet, Farming, Fishing, Pokemon Cards, Casino, Arena, Dungeon, etc.**), you must agree to the Game Terms.

By agreeing, you agree to play fairly, follow community guidelines, and allow the storage of your game progression data.

Do you agree?
